about: {name} is a D2C brand that sells car perfume.
description: {name} case study: product and bundle-builder pages for a car perfume range, with matching social creative, a Meta carousel and a Google Shopping ad.
brief: {name} sells car perfume. We built product and bundle-builder pages for the range, paired with social creative and ads for the same products.
The storefront, the ads and the social creative share one look, so an ad and the page it points to read as the same brand.
